source_repo.note: repo transferred from materialsvirtuallab to materialyzeai; GitHub redirects both API and raw URLs

redistribution_conditions: retain copyright notice, condition list, and disclaimer; no endorsement use of the Materials Virtual Lab name; cite Zuo et al. 2019

label_units.virial_stress: kbar, 6-component Voigt (inferred from magnitudes vs Cu elastic constants; not explicitly documented -- H1 open item)

periodic: all configurations carry a full pymatgen lattice matrix; surfaces are periodic slabs with vacuum

groups.name: Elastic
groups.detail: 6 strain modes x 20 strains (-10%..+10%, 1% steps) + 1 ground state crystal; 108-atom 3x3x3 fcc cells

groups.name: AIMD-NVT
groups.detail: 40 snapshots each at 300 K, 1000 K, 3000 K; 108-atom bulk; 0.1 ps interval

groups.name: Vacancy
groups.detail: 20 snapshots each at 300 K, 3000 K; 107-atom single-vacancy cells

groups.name: Surface
groups.detail: slabs from Crystalium/mp-30, Miller indices (100)..(332); 6-48 atoms

dft.kpoints: 4x4x4 for Cu supercells; Gamma-only for AIMD (paper-stated)
dft.verification_status: all DFT settings are paper statements; JSONs carry no INCAR/KPOINTS/POTCAR metadata

overlap_risk.verdict: low direct overlap with MPTrj; moderate distributional familiarity for foundation-model baselines
overlap_risk.rationale: custom 2019 strain/AIMD/vacancy/surface configurations, not MP relaxation trajectories; MPTrj (2023) contains only bulk MP task trajectories. Equilibrium fcc Cu (mp-30) and its relaxation frames ARE in MPTrj, so the ground-state/small-strain region is familiar to MACE-MP-0; surface slabs derive geometrically from mp-30 but slab frames are not MPTrj members.

suitability.verdict: suitable for Phase 2 vertical slice with constraints
constraints: mlearn's own 31-config test set is only 10.6% -- a project re-split is required to reach >=20% frozen test
acquisition pool capped at ~172 (low end of 128-512)
Surface group has only 12 configs; per-group Surface metrics will be weak
AIMD snapshots are temporally correlated within only 5 trajectories; use time-block splitting and preregister the policy

discrepancies_paper_vs_data: paper says 20 AIMD / 40 vacancy snapshots; data has 40 AIMD / 20 vacancy
paper says 2% strain intervals; Cu data has 1% intervals
paper describes AIMD temps as multiples of melting point; Cu data uses literal 300/1000/3000 K
